content.text:
You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: The module specifies the classic Paxos consensus protocol without explicit leader or learner roles. It models four replicas acting as both proposers and acceptors over a fixed set of ballots and values, with quorums defined as any three-of-four majority subsets of replicas.

The state consists of a global message set (`messages`) and per-acceptor variables tracking the highest ballot seen (`maxBallot`), the highest ballot at which a value was accepted (`maxVBallot`), the corresponding accepted value (`maxValue`), and a single `decision` variable representing any learnt value. The five actions implement standard Paxos phases: `PaxosPrepare` broadcasts a Phase 1a prepare for any nonzero ballot; `PaxosPromise` has an acceptor respond with a Phase 1b promise when the incoming ballot exceeds its current maximum; `PaxosAccept` fires when a proposer has collected Phase 1b responses from a full quorum and sends a Phase 2a accept carrying either the value associated with the highest previously accepted ballot (via `ForcedValue`) or any freely chosen value if no prior acceptance exists; `PaxosAccepted` has an acceptor record and broadcast a Phase 2b acceptance when the ballot is at least its current maximum; and `PaxosDecide` sets `decision` once a quorum has sent matching Phase 2b messages for a ballot. The temporal specification requires strong fairness on `PaxosDecide`. Safety is checked via `PaxosNontriviality` (only proposed values are learnt) and `PaxosConsistency` (the decision value never changes once set), while liveness is explicitly declared `FALSE`, acknowledging FLP impossibility.
